mapper.select: SELECT `dept_role`.`dept_id` AS `of_id`, `role`.`id` AS `role_id`, `role`.`code` AS `role_code`, `role`.`type` AS `role_type`, `role`.`name` AS `role_name`, `role`.`data_scope`, `role`.`data_scopes` FROM `upms_sys_dept_role_bind` AS `dept_role` LEFT JOIN `upms_sys_role` AS `role` ON `dept_role`.`role_id` = `role`.`id` AND `role`.`is_delete` = 0 WHERE `dept_role`.`dept_id` = #{deptId}

SELECT `dept_role`.`dept_id` AS `of_id`, IF(`dept_role`.`dept_id` IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS `checked`, IF(`role`.`type` = 1, 1, 0) AS `disabled`, `role`.`id` AS `role_id`, `role`.`code` AS `role_code`, IF(`role`.`type`= 1, 1, 0) AS `disable`, `role`.`name` AS `role_name`, `role`.`data_scope`, `role`.`data_scopes` FROM `upms_sys_role` AS `role` LEFT JOIN `upms_sys_dept_role_bind` AS `dept_role` ON `dept_role`.`role_id` = `role`.`id` AND `dept_role`.`dept_id` = #{query.ofId} WHERE `role`.`is_delete` = 0
